name: AT&T Inc.
description: AT&T operates two reportable segments: Communications (Mobility wireless, Business Wireline serving enterprise/wholesale customers, and Consumer Wireline broadband including AT&T Fiber) and Latin America (wireless service and equipment in Mexico). AT&T completed the sale of its remaining 70% stake in DirecTV to TPG Capital on 2025-07-02, fully exiting the traditional pay-TV business it had entered via the 2015 DirecTV and 2018 Time Warner acquisitions (Time Warner/WarnerMedia was separately spun off and merged with Discovery in 2022). AT&T's current strategy centers on converged fiber-plus-wireless growth, targeting more than 40 million fiber passings by the end of 2026 and continuing to buy AT&T Internet Air fixed-wireless subscribers in areas without fiber.

geography.method: Regional revenue tagged in the filing's own XBRL instance: full-year contexts with one geographic dimension (or segments named after places), alone or crossed only with operating segments or a revenue line of the income statement; regions must add up to the revenue line within 1 percent; a member equal to the sum of others is a subtotal; the main split is the largest set of members adding up to the total; anything not broken out is a computed remainder.
